item.title: Abandoned car advertising scam scrap service., 18th August
item.description:
This car has been abandoned at the bottom of Victoria Way. They are a 'we buy any car' service that purchases used cars for scrap, these cars are then sold to rogue traders across London who sell them on for hundreds, thousands of pounds of profit without informing buyers that they are faulty. The car is insured but does not have a valid MOT and, presumably, does not have a permit, thus it is illegally parked in a CPZ. It has been clamped, presumably by the owner. Please remove it and fine the owner.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Victoria Way, Charlton
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Hedge too thick and tall blocking view of traffic, 18th August
item.description:
The hedge outside our drive is so thick and tall that we cannot see any oncoming traffic coming down from Wickham Way/Chinese Roundabout. Often cars are coming down at an unacceptable speed. There has been many near accident occasions because we simply cannot see what’s coming down on the road. There is a team of maintenance cutting the hedge on our road yesterday and we talked to them about the problem and asked them politely to cut it down so it’s no longer dangerous. However the hedge is a little tidier today but there is no difference in height and thickness. Please kindly and urgently send someone out to reduce the height and thickness to avoid potential traffic accidents. Thank you.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 25, Hayes Way, Beckenham, Greater London
